scope: Sourced facts on large experiments' detectors: design, achieved and operating values as separate ledger claims, each with its source, location, configuration (valid_for) and read level. ATLAS, CMS, LHCb, IceCube, Super-Kamiokande and Fermi-LAT (v1); Belle II, ALICE, DUNE, JUNO, XENONnT and the Pierre Auger Observatory (batch D); about ten claims each.
exclusions: Numbers not in the ledger: the atlas answers unknown, never from memory
AMS-02: only a link to its experiment profile (experiment:ams-02)
ALICE, Belle II, DUNE, JUNO, XENONnT or LZ and the Pierre Auger Observatory: deferred to the batch D expansion (D13)
Internal or unpublished collaboration numbers; performance claims beyond what the cited paper states for the stated configuration
maintainer: hchouTW (public-document reference; not endorsed by any collaboration)

capabilities.name: sourced-detector-atlas
capabilities.scope: Structural validity of the ledger and its atlas blocks (complete block, allowed kind, values as written in the claim sentence), index sync and coverage; not the truth of any claim; validation, rendering with claim ids and querying through skills/hep-detector/scripts/detector_atlas.py
